bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs (player), springboard/src/media/ (player, stream, capture), springboard/src/deildu/player_view.rs, springboard/src/shell/camera/
summary: AVKit's playback side has partial BifrOSt counterparts: a video decoder and fullscreen player, and a floating audio mini player. Picture in Picture, route picking, the content-proposal and chapter UI, and capture hardware buttons, audio input picker and Continuity Camera have no counterpart; the PiP toggle in Settings is stored but nothing acts on it.

features.note: Fullscreen video with transport HUD is used by Deildu and Files, but there is no app-facing SDK player view controller; the SDK player() widget in springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs:900 is an audio capsule, not a video view.

features.feature: Transport controls and audio mini player
features.apple: AVPlayerViewController transport UI, MPRemoteCommandCenter via player
features.note: Floating capsule with skip, play and progress; audio only, no video surface in the capsule.

Wave 3 (w3-avkit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Only the Start PiP Automatically preference exists; no floating video window, no start/stop API, no delegate events. Nothing reads pip_auto when the Home button is pressed.

features.feature: Playback of immersive, multiview and interstitial media
features.apple: AVExperienceController, AVMultiviewManager, AVGroupExperienceCoordinator, AVViewport, AVInterstitialTimeRange, AVNavigationMarkersGroup
features.note: visionOS and HLS interstitial features; no counterpart found in springboard/src/media/ or the SDK.

Wave 3 (w3-avkit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No next-up proposal sheet in the SDK or the media apps.

features.apple: AVPlayerViewTrimResult, trimming in a macOS player
features.note: Wave 6 (b12, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. No trim control in the player HUD (springboard/src/deildu/player_view.rs).
No display mode switching API; the video path is in springboard/src/media/ only.
Settings page only; no route picker view. Deildu serves a LAN URL so an external TV can play the stream (springboard/CHANGELOG.md), which is not an AVRoutePicker equivalent.

features.apple: AVKit metadata identifiers, third-party casting support
features.note: No casting SDK; metadata identifiers are Apple-specific.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs (viewfinder, silent shutter, timer, grid, QR), springboard/src/shell/camera/qr.rs
features.note: The Camera app is a shell app, not an SDK view. Apps get no capture view or delegate, and the camera is not exposed as a reusable widget.

Wave 5 (w5-avkit, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No hardware capture button handler; the shutter is on-screen only.
Front and back switching exists; no direction coordinator or device descriptor API for apps.

Wave 5 (w5-avkit, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The audio service records (Recorder, level, elapsed) but no input-device picker UI or SDK API is offered to apps.

features.apple: Camera in Split View, Slide Over, PiP, Stage Manager
features.note: BifrOSt has no iPad multitasking modes; the camera runs only in the shell's Camera app.
Apple device pairing; no counterpart planned in the repo.
Media errors exist as a Rust Error enum; no AVKit error codes, and the content-restriction codes have no counterpart.

gaps: Picture in Picture: no floating video window or PiP controller API; the Settings toggle pip_auto (springboard/src/shell/options.rs:72) is stored but never read by the shell.

App-facing video player view: the SDK player() widget (springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs:900) draws audio only; the fullscreen video HUD lives in springboard/src/deildu/player_view.rs and is not reusable by other apps.
Route picker: no AVRoutePickerView equivalent for AirPlay or nearby receivers; the AirPlay & Handoff page (springboard/src/shell/pages.rs:598) is a settings screen only.
Capture: no SDK capture view or delegate (AVCaptureView); the camera is a single shell app (springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs).
Capture events: no hardware button interaction API.
Audio input picker: audiod records (springboard/audiod/src/main.rs) but apps cannot choose a microphone through a system picker.
Content proposals, trimming and display-mode switching have no counterpart.
